entities.summary: Archbishop Anton Tamarut was a Croatian Roman Catholic prelate who served as a diocesan bishop of Šibenik (1986–1987), and after that, as a coadjutor archbishop (1987–1990) and an archbishop of Rijeka since 1990 until his death in 2000.
